title: Design System: Local blind rating instrument

body.purpose: Default interface text and inherited button typography.

components.name: Rating button
components.description: Explicit rating choice with selected, disabled, and visible keyboard-focus states.
components.css: .ds-rating-button { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #555; border-radius: .25rem; padding: .65rem .8rem; color: #222; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rating-button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #444; color: #fff; } .ds-shortcut { color: #555; font-size: .9em; } .ds-rating-button[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-shortcut { color: #fff; } .ds-rating-button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; } .ds-rating-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1e4c79; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pair image panel
components.description: Equal-size scrollable image well for side-by-side comparison, with compact viewport sizing and a single-column mobile layout.
components.css: .ds-pair-frames { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .75rem; } .ds-pair-frames figure { min-width: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-pair-frames figcaption { font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 .35rem; } .ds-pair-image-frame { width: 100%; height: min(56vh, 660px); min-height: 320px; overflow: auto; background: #777; display: flex; align-items: safe center; justify-content: safe center; } .ds-pair-image-frame img { display: block; max-width: none; max-height: none; object-fit: contain; flex: none; } @media (max-width: 1050px) { .ds-pair-image-frame { height: min(46vh, 460px); min-height: 260px; } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-pair-frames { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-pair-image-frame { height: 36vh; min-height: 220px; } }

components.description: Neutral, bordered area that identifies the active rubric and keeps the canonical wording in a native disclosure.

components.css: .ds-rubric-adoption { border-bottom: 1px solid #c9c7c4; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; padding: 0 0 1rem; } .ds-rubric-adoption details { margin-top: .75rem; } .ds-rubric-adoption summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; } .ds-rubric-adoption summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1e4c79; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (min-width: 961px) and (max-width: 1050px) { .ds-rubric-adoption { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(16rem, .8fr); column-gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: .75rem; padding-bottom: .75rem; } .ds-rubric-adoption p { margin-bottom: .35rem; } .ds-rubric-heading, .ds-rubric-version, .ds-rubric-guidance { grid-column: 1; } .ds-adopt-action { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; align-self: start; } .ds-adoption-status { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; } .ds-rubric-adoption details { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; } }

components.name: Review status controls
components.description: Divider-separated review metadata with a labeled note field and visible keyboard focus.
components.html: <section class="ds-review-status"><label for="ds-review-note">Resolution note</label><textarea id="ds-review-note"></textarea><button type="button">Resolve review</button></section>
components.css: .ds-review-status { border-top: 1px solid #c9c7c4; margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: .25rem; } .ds-review-status textarea { display: block; width: min(100%, 36rem); font: inherit; margin: .3rem 0 .7rem; } .ds-review-status textarea:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1e4c79; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sticky sitting navigation
components.description: Compact navigation remains at the viewport bottom when needed and stays visually separated from the workspace.
components.css: .ds-sitting-navigation { position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 2; display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .75rem; margin: 1rem 0; padding: .65rem 0; background: #f4f3f1; border-top: 1px solid #c9c7c4; } .ds-sitting-navigation button { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #555; border-radius: .25rem; padding: .65rem .8rem; color: #222; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sitting-navigation button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1e4c79; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
This is an operate interface for one reviewer working through an existing blind sitting. The observed visual system gives the images and explicit choices most of the attention. Neutral page and control colors, system typography, and simple borders support scanning without adding visual cues about an answer.

The values below are a snapshot extracted from `static/style.css`. That stylesheet remains the implementation source of truth. The interface currently has no shadow or motion rules.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral page and control surfaces with a gray image well.
System UI typography and compact heading hierarchy.
Equal-sized pair panels with synchronized scrolling.
Visible keyboard focus and selected-choice state.
A quiet rubric-adoption band before the sitting workspace, with the full rubric available in a native disclosure.
A separate review-status area for identity or target flags, note-backed resolution, and retained history.
dos: Do preserve equal pair-panel sizing and the image aspect ratio.
Do keep keyboard focus visible with the stylesheet's focus outline.
Do keep selected choices visibly distinct from default choices.
Do preserve native button, label, textarea, disclosure, and heading semantics for the adoption and review controls.
Do keep the focus outline visible on every interactive control, including disclosure summaries and resolution notes.
donts: Don't add decorative shadows or motion that are absent from the current interface.
Don't add visual styling that suggests a preferred rating.
